page_title: EverAlice AI — Etsy Listing & Product Launch Studio

sources.entry: EverAlice AI - All-in-one AI studio for Etsy and digital-product sellers: turns one artwork or idea into listing copy and SEO tags for 25 marketplaces, studio mockups, print-ready files, listing videos, a launch marketing pack and a customer delivery ZIP, with bulk runs of up to 100 products. #freemium

summary.name: EverAlice AI
summary.one_liner: An AI studio that turns one artwork or idea into Etsy-ready listing copy, SEO tags, mockups, print files and a customer delivery ZIP.
use_cases: Creating a complete Etsy listing from one artwork
Generating SEO titles, tags and descriptions for multiple marketplaces
Making studio mockups of digital or physical products
Preparing print files in common ratios
Bulk-listing up to 100 products in one run
Packaging customer delivery files as a ZIP
summary.what_it_does: The Magic Lister takes an uploaded artwork (PNG, JPG, SVG) or an AI-generated design and produces platform-specific titles, tags, descriptions and SEO copy in one pass. It also creates studio-style mockups, print-ready files in common ratios, and a customer delivery ZIP with instructions. The page says it supports Single, Bundle and Bulk modes, with Bulk handling up to 100 listings, and lists Etsy, Shopify, KDP and Gumroad among target platforms. Other tools on the page include a niche scorer, Smart Resize, an Etsy Photo Sizer, background removal and slideshow or AI video generation. Pricing is credit-based with free starter credits and paid monthly plans.
notable: One upload generates listing copy, SEO tags, mockups, print files and a delivery ZIP together
Bulk mode for up to 100 products per run
Free starter credits with no card required, plus free non-AI utilities like Smart Resize and Etsy Photo Sizer
Built by a self-described Etsy seller, with a founder who is neurodivergent
caveats: Most AI actions consume credits; monthly plans start at $15 intro then $20/month
Purchased credits and plan details depend on the published policy; first paid subscription refunds are not automatic and a $2 processing fee applies
Generation time depends on product, provider and file size
